AWeekOfChores
Ana plans her week. She writes down three chores, one with no date yet,
    hands one to Bo, finishes one and crosses it off, renames another, and
    moves the first one's due date back a day. Then she looks at what is left
    for her.

TheDayPasses
Bo schedules two chores for tomorrow and the day after, then two days go by.
    The first is overdue and rises to the top of the list; Bo can still rename it,
    and can push it to today, but not to a day that has passed.
ClearTheList\nAt the end of the week Ana removes everything, one chore at a time, and\n    the list says there is nothing to do. Removing one twice is turned away.

WrongTurns
Ana makes the mistakes a form lets her make: a blank title, a date that
    has passed, a colleague who does not exist. Each is turned away with its
    reason and the list is as it was. Then she gets it right.

SaveTwiceMakesOneTodo
Ana types a chore and, impatient, presses Save a second time while the
    first request is out. One todo lands, because Save is disabled while
    saving.

EditKeepsWhatWasTyped
Bo edits a chore and moves its date to last week by mistake. The form is
    refused with the reason, keeps what he typed, and the row is untouched. He
    fixes the date and saves.

OfflineShowsTheLastList
Ana adds two chores, then loses the network. The list she saw stays on
    screen with a banner, Save and Remove are off, and when the network returns
    the list is fresh again.

EveryLabelReadsInFrench
Opened in French, every control a reader can see carries its French label
    as its accessible name, on the list, the add form, the edit form and the
    remove dialog.

# Todos  (/)
first screen

components:
  list-title         text      'Todos'
  list-search        text      'Search'  filters by title or description as you type
  list-assignee      select    'Assignee'  filters by owner  lists: 'Anyone', the users received, by name; holds everyone a todo the list holds is assigned to
  list-status        select    'Status'  filters by derived status  options: Any, Unscheduled, Scheduled, Overdue
  list-loading       spinner    the first fetch is out
  list-empty         text      'Nothing to do'  the fetch returned no row
  todo-list          text       one row per todo, in the API's order
  row-title          text      (per row)
  row-assignee       text      (per row)
  row-due            text      (per row)
  row-status         text      (per row)  one of the three status labels
  row-edit           button    'Edit' (per row)  replaces this row with the edit form
  row-remove         button    'Remove' (per row)  opens the remove dialog for this row
  offline-banner     banner    "You're offline"  navigator.onLine is false

sends (to /todos):
  GET /todos
  GET /users

stored:
  rows         the todos of the last successful fetch, as the API sent them  (starts [])
  loaded       whether any fetch has answered  (starts false)
  filters      text, assignee, status as typed and chosen  (starts all empty)
  editingId    the id of the row shown as the edit form, or null  (starts null)
  removingId   the id the remove dialog asks about, or null  (starts null)
  online       navigator.onLine, kept current by the online/offline events  (starts navigator.onLine)

phases:
  loading    shows list-loading; hides todo-list, list-empty
  empty      shows list-empty; hides list-loading, todo-list
  ready      shows todo-list; hides list-loading, list-empty
  offline    shows offline-banner, todo-list; disabled row-remove; because a write cannot reach the API; the rows are the last fetch

transitions:
  loading --[200 with rows]--> ready; rows replaced
  loading --[200 with no row]--> empty
  ready --[change list-search]--> ready; refetch within 200 ms
  ready --[change list-assignee]--> ready; refetch
  ready --[change list-status]--> ready; refetch
  ready --[a write answered 2xx]--> ready; refetch
  ready --[60 s pass]--> ready; refetch
  ready --[click row-edit]--> ready; editingId = row id; the row is the edit form
  ready --[click row-remove]--> ready; removingId = row id; the dialog opens
  ready --[offline event]--> offline; no refetch until online
  offline --[online event]--> ready; refetch

# Add a todo
inside: add-form
reached from: ListPage: always shown above the list

components:
  textbox 'Title'    field     'Title'
  todo-description   textarea  'Description'
  todo-due           date      'Due date'    holds string (date) as due_on
  combobox 'Assignee' select    'Assignee'    lists: 'Nobody', the users received, by name
  button 'Save'      button    'Save'  POST /todos with the non-empty fields
  todo-saving        spinner    the request is out
  todo-error         text       the API's error text, role=alert

sends (to /todos):
  POST /todos
  GET /users

stored:
  title        any text; Save needs it non-blank  (starts "")
  description  any text  (starts "")
  due          YYYY-MM-DD or empty  (starts "")
  assignee     "" | "ana" | "bo"  (starts "")
  phase        idle | saving | refused  (starts idle)
  error        the last refusal's message, or empty  (starts "")

phases:
  idle       hides todo-saving, todo-error; because Save is enabled only when the title is not blank
  saving     shows todo-saving; disabled textbox 'Title', todo-description, todo-due, combobox 'Assignee', button 'Save'
  refused    shows todo-error; because the fields keep what was typed

transitions:
  idle --[click button 'Save' only if title is not blank and online]--> saving
  saving --[201]--> idle; fields cleared; list refetched
  saving --[4xx or 5xx]--> refused; error = body.error; fields kept
  saving --[network error]--> refused; error = a generic message
  refused --[edit any field]--> idle; error hidden
  refused --[click button 'Save' only if title is not blank]--> saving

inside: edit-form

components:
  todo-title         field     'Title'
  todo-description   textarea  'Description'
  todo-due           date      'Due date'    holds string (date) as due_on
  todo-due-clear     button    'Clear due date'  empties the date and marks it cleared
  todo-assignee      select    'Assignee'    lists: 'Nobody', the users received, by name
  todo-save          button    'Save'  PATCH /todos/{id} with the changed fields only; a cleared date is null
  todo-cancel        button    'Cancel'  the row comes back unchanged
  todo-saving        spinner
  todo-error         text       the API's error text, role=alert

sends (to /todos):
  PUT /todos
  GET /users

stored:
  title, description, due, assignee as the add form, prefilled from the row  (starts the row's values)
  dueCleared   whether Clear due date was pressed since the last save  (starts false)
  phase        idle | saving | refused  (starts idle)
  error        the last refusal's message, or empty  (starts "")

phases:
  idle       hides todo-saving, todo-error
  saving     shows todo-saving; disabled todo-title, todo-description, todo-due, todo-due-clear, todo-assignee, todo-save, todo-cancel
  refused    shows todo-error; because the fields keep what was typed

transitions:
  idle --[click todo-save only if title is not blank and online]--> saving
  idle --[click todo-cancel]--> idle; editingId = null; the row is back
  idle --[click todo-due-clear]--> idle; due = empty; dueCleared = true
  saving --[200]--> idle; editingId = null; list refetched
  saving --[4xx or 5xx]--> refused; error = body.error; fields kept
  refused --[edit any field]--> idle; error hidden

  DELETE /todos

stored:
  removingId   the row asked about  (starts the row's id)

phases:
  open       shows remove-dialog, remove-confirm, remove-cancel
  removing   disabled remove-confirm, remove-cancel

transitions:
  open --[click remove-confirm]--> removing
  removing --[204]--> open; removingId = null; dialog closed; list refetched
  removing --[4xx or 5xx]--> open; the error text is shown in the dialog
  open --[click remove-cancel]--> open; removingId = null; dialog closed

- **(none)**: no todo is listed. Reached by: a fresh service, nothing done.
- **unscheduled**: 'Fix the gate' is listed with no due day. Reached by: AddTodo Fix the gate.
- **scheduled**: 'Fix the gate' is listed with a due day on or after today. Reached by: AddTodo Fix the gate.
- **overdue**: 'Fix the gate' is listed with a due day before today. Reached by: AddTodo Fix the gate; DayPasses 2026-11-07.
- **Online**: every act reaches the store. Reached by: a fresh service, nothing done.
- **Offline**: the banner shows; Save and Remove are off; the list is the last fetch. Reached by: SetNetwork offline.
- **StoreDown**: an act that reaches the store is turned away with the API's words. Reached by: SetStore down.
